# Review of small-scale response surfaces

## Ridge-shaped responses

Two-variable yield surfaces often form a correlated ridge: a hotter but shorter run can match a cooler but
longer run. Sequential one-factor searches tend to stall on such ridges.

## Catalyst screening practice

Screening studies usually report both yield and TON, because a high loading can buy yield at the cost of TON.
